annotations.title: Search lenders, BDCs, borrowers, sponsors and credit funds

description: The capital structure graph behind private markets, built from every BDC's schedule of investments each quarter since 2022. `query` is a name (trigram matched across names and aliases: Ares, Ares Capital and ARCC resolve to the adviser, the BDC and its ticker as distinct rows); without a query, filters list providers (class, state, BDC advisers only) or borrowers (sponsor, industry, minimum BDC lenders, maturity before a date, sort). Every row names its fact class (filed: the BDC's own figure; derived: arithmetic over filed figures, a sum of pieces is a lower bound; carried: from another DFX graph with its source; inferred: an attribution by rule with confidence). A mark below cost is a mark, not impairment; a moved maturity is an observed term change, not an amendment; non-accrual and default are not on the tape and are never inferred.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of this tool, unchanged.

entity_type.description: Default: any type with a query; providers without one. borrower lists exclude grade C groups.

industry.description: Industry as a filer wrote it (contains).

maturity_before.description: ISO date: borrowers whose next dated maturity is on or before it.

min_lenders.description: Borrowers held by at least this many BDCs.

sponsor_dfx_id.description: A private credit graph id of the form dfx:pc:<uuid> (from search_private_credit, resolve_name or search_entities).
